resources.string: Live television from around the world, in one calm and simple app.
Browse channels by country, language and category. No playlists to find, no files to download, nothing to configure.
Free channels stay free. Every channel comes from an approved source and is tested for real playback before it appears. If a channel is unstable or offline, TVKu tells you.

You get 5 hours of premium features to try. After that, free channels remain available. Optional donations via WhatsApp keep TVKu running and unlock premium after an admin verifies them. There are no automatic payments.

TVKu creates a random installation ID and stores a one-way hash of this device\'s app-specific Android ID, only to keep the 5-hour trial fair. TVKu does not access your contacts, messages, location, phone number or storage, and does not track you for advertising.
